title: Route-action closure production guard
rationale: Priority dashboard surfaces must not be considered production ready unless their UI action path, frontend client path, backend FastAPI route and error/no-content handling are all proven together.
fixed_defects: Contracts frontend client used non-proxied /contracts paths instead of /api/v1/contracts.
No production guard existed to fail closed when a priority UI action lost its backend route or frontend marker.

pass1: pytest selected Test Center readiness/health: 2 passed
npm run lint -- src/lib/api/client.ts: 0 errors, existing warnings only

rollback_plan: Revert route_action_closure.py and its endpoint if the guard blocks a release incorrectly.
Keep the /api/v1/contracts client path repair unless the backend routing contract changes.
Remove PROD_R7_ROUTE_ACTION_CLOSURE_PASS12.md to make ProductionReadinessRunner block production ready again.
residual_risk: This freeze proves route-action contracts and response handling. It does not replace browser click-through testing with real operator data.
